aiCapex.label: Combined 2026 capital spending guidance of Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta, mostly for AI data centres
aiCapex.note: Company guidance, not actual spend. Alphabet ($195-205B) and Meta ($130-145B, incl. finance-lease principal) gave ranges; midpoints used. Microsoft's $175B is its calendar-2026 reported-capex estimate after a lease-accounting change; its previous estimate was $190B. Amazon: about $220B.

cancerFunding.label: Fiscal year 2026 budget of the US National Cancer Institute, the largest funder of cancer research in the world
cancerFunding.note: For a wider view: a 2025 Lancet Oncology analysis counted about $51.4B in public and philanthropic cancer research awards worldwide over 2016–2023, roughly $6.4B a year (an earlier 2023 analysis found about $24.5B over 2016–2020). These count research awards only, which is why NCI’s budget alone is larger.

sources.title: Study reveals global inequalities in cancer research funding

curable.text: Thanks to decades of research, screening and better treatment, some cancers are now often curable: about 90% of children with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia survive five years, and 99% with early testicular cancer (US data).

aiCured.text: None has been cured by AI. As of October 2026, no AI-discovered drug has full FDA approval for any disease.
